name: Lust By Appointment
source:
Welcome to your story.

You weren’t always a male escort.
You were just someone behind the bar — a smooth-talking bartender with nothing but a shaker in your hand and a dream too dangerous to say out loud.

Until she walked in.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3822270/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到你的故事。

你并不总是男伴游。
你只是吧台后面的一个人——一个能说会道的调酒师，手里除了一个摇酒器什么都没有，还有一个无法大声说出来的危险梦想。

直到她走进来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3822270/]Steam[/url]]
